options.name: aggregate_name
options.description: The aggregate in which the volume will be created. If not provided, Cloud Manager chooses the best aggregate.

options.name: capacity_tier
options.description: The volume's capacity tier for tiering cold data to object storage. The default values for each cloud provider are as follows. Amazon as 'S3', Azure as 'Blob', GCP as 'cloudStorage'. If 'NONE', the capacity tier will not be set on volume creation.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The connector ID of the Cloud Manager Connector.

options.name: enable_compression
options.description: Enabling cpmpression. Default to true if not specified.

options.name: enable_deduplication
options.description: Enabling deduplication. Default to true if not specified.

options.name: enable_thin_provisioning
options.description: Enabling thin provisioning. Default to true if not specified.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: export_policy_ip
options.description: Custom export policy list of IPs (NFS protocol parameters).

options.name: export_policy_nfs_version
options.description: Export policy protocol (NFS protocol parameters).

options.name: export_policy_type
options.description: The export policy type (NFS protocol parameters).

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: igroups
options.description: List of igroups (iSCSI protocol parameters).

options.name: initiators
options.description: Set of attributes of Initiators (iSCSI protocol parameters).

options.name: iops
options.description: Provisioned IOPS. Needed only when provider_volume_type is "io1".

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the volume.

options.name: os_name
options.description: Operating system (iSCSI protocol parameters).

options.name: permission
options.description: CIFS share permission type (CIFS protocol parameters).

options.name: provider_volume_type
options.description: The underlying cloud provider volume type. For AWS is ["gp3", "gp2", "io1", "st1", "sc1"]. For Azure is ['Premium_LRS','Standard_LRS','StandardSSD_LRS']. For GCP is ['pd-balanced','pd-ssd','pd-standard'].

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: The refresh token for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_client_id
options.description: The service account secret client ID for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_secret_key
options.description: The service account secret key for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: share_name
options.description: Share name (CIFS protocol parameters).

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the volume.

options.name: size_unit
options.description: The size unit of volume.

options.name: snapshot_policy_name
options.description: The snapshot policy name.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified volume should exist or not.

options.name: svm_name
options.description: The name of the SVM. The default SVM name is used, if a name is not provided.

options.name: tenant_id
options.description: The NetApp account ID that the Connector will be associated with. To be used only when using FSx.

options.name: throughput
options.description: Unit is Mb/s. Valid range 125-1000. Required only when provider_volume_type is 'gp3'.

options.name: tiering_policy
options.description: The tiering policy.

options.name: users
options.description: List of users with the permission (CIFS protocol parameters).

options.name: volume_protocol
options.description: The protocol for the volume. This affects the provided parameters.

options.name: working_environment_id
options.description: The public ID of the working environment where the volume will be created.

options.name: working_environment_name
options.description: The working environment name where the volume will be created.
